03 / BUILT AROUND YOUR WORK

Your time.
Your craft.
Your kind of busy.

For the people doing the work.
And the teams making it happen.

What is Swiftime?

Swiftime is an AI-powered time tracking app. You describe your work in one sentence, typed or spoken, and it turns that sentence into a structured time entry with client, project, duration, and date already filled in.

How does Swiftime's AI time entry work?

Type or say something like "worked 2.5h on the Acme homepage redesign yesterday from 1pm." Swiftime parses the natural language and fills in the client, project, duration, and date fields automatically.

Can I track time by voice?

Yes. Speech input is included on Starter and Pro. Speak your entry and Swiftime transcribes and structures it the same way as typed input.

How much does Swiftime cost?

Start with the free forever plan, or make room for more.

Starter$6/monthwhen billed annually

Pro$12/monthwhen billed annually

One price per account. Starter includes 3 team members; Pro includes 10. Compare all plans.

Can my AI assistant log time for me?

Yes. Pro accounts get an API key, so AI tools like Claude can create time entries through the API without opening the app.

Do I need an account to try Swiftime?

No. Guest mode lets you try Swiftime without signing up.

MAKE A LITTLE ROOM IN YOUR DAY

Your work takes time.
Tracking it shouldn’t.

Try Swiftime for free

No signup needed. Just your first sentence.
